name: Level Meter
author: Kyle-Hosman
summary: A level meter for each deck on a Mod Menu page: RMS as a bar, the peak as a marker that holds, and the peak in dBFS.
description:
Adds a page under Mod Menu > Community Mods > Installed > Level Meter with one meter per deck in the current view (2 or 4).

The XDJ-AZ mixes its channels in hardware, so the meter shows each deck's own output before the mixer: the channel fader, EQ and crossfader do not move it. A peak at or above -1 dBFS is shown in red.

It is an example for mod authors. It listens to the decks read-only through the AZ-MODS core's audio taps, which never delay the audio. It does not patch the deck's code, change any control, LED or audio, write files, or use the network.
